name: AI Webform Sentiment
description: Analyzes webform submissions for sentiment using ai (with chart.js visualization).
project_description:
AI sentiment analysis on webform submissions 
 This module gives you the possibility to 

 
 Use AI to score webform submissions on positive/negative. 
 Use AI to visualise the clusters of themes in the webform submissions 
 
 We leverage the AI module LLM capability to calculate a sentiment score for each submission.

This allows you to track the average submission emotion and the sentiment trend in Drupal. 

 Configuration 
 
 Add a handler to the webform 
 Configure the sentiment handler (choose a PROMPT and a Large Language Model). 
 (optional) Change the prompt to use more granular or less granular scoring. you can make it score from 0-5 or from 5-10 or ... (currently only supporting numeric). 
 Make sure cron runs 
 
 Usage 
 Go to the webform results page, click on Sentiment. See the scores.

They will be updated per cron run.

 Requirements 
 
 Cron configured and running 
 chartjs_api 
 
 Warning 1 
 The dashboard uses some heavy queries (avg/sum/) with grouping.

It might be that the module needs some more production testing and load testing. happy to accept suggestions. Be careful installing this on production.

 Warning 2 
 If you have many webform submissions. For every LLM evaluation we will do a call which may cost you money. You should be aware.
